text: Sankashti means 'the difficulty' — the day is kept for facing what is stuck in your life, with Ganapati as the one who clears the way.
It is about starting, not about waiting.
Offer durva and a little jaggery.
Do the evening pooja after moonrise if that suits your home.
Name one thing you have been putting off,
and take the first small step on it today.
